Stops screenshots and screen recording of apps in the space, and blanks them in Recents.
Hide notification content on lock screen
Notifications from the space show without their text while the phone is locked.
Copy and paste between the space and the rest of the phone is blocked in both directions.
Hides contacts in the space from contact search and caller ID outside it.
Some privacy settings could not be applied on this device
Every app in the space and all of its data will be permanently deleted. There is no backup and this cannot be undone.
Keep apps in a space of their own
Second Space is a separate, locked area of your phone. Apps you add live there with their own data and accounts, and need your lock to open.
Unlock with your Second Space lock to see your apps.
Nothing here yet. Open the ⋮ menu and choose Add apps.
Get apps from the Play Store
Opens the Play Store inside Second Space
Preparing the Play Store. Tap again in a moment.
If lock, freeze or privacy changes stop working, check the connection, then repair the space. If it can\'t be reached, pause and resume Work apps in Quick Settings.
Second Space is not reachable. Pause and resume Work apps in Quick Settings.
Could not reach Second Space. Pause and resume Work apps in Quick Settings, then try again.
Could not reach Second Space. Setting not changed.

When Second Space locks, its apps are hidden and stopped, and nothing arrives until you open it again. It locks when the screen turns off. While open, a small notification keeps the lock listener alive. If Cloak loses its pairing while apps are hidden, they cannot be shown again without deleting the space.
Also hide apps on restart (may not finish)

Tries to hide the apps when the phone shuts down or restarts. Android only allows a short time for this, so with many or heavy apps it may not finish. Apps are hidden again after the restart either way, and always need the work PIN.
Hide apps again after a restart (recommended)

After the phone restarts, Cloak hides the apps that were open before. If this is off, they stay visible until you open Cloak, which then hides them and asks for the PIN again. They always need the work PIN either way.
Planned: also hide apps without a launcher icon. Not available yet.
